decision: Selected the centroid of Wake County tax parcel 1716964146 (5301 DEPARTURE DR), as published in the NC OneMap statewide parcel layer, as the reviewed site locator for TierPoint's Raleigh (RAL) data center at 5301 Departure Drive, Raleigh.
layer: NC OneMap NC1Map_Parcels FeatureServer layer 1 (Wake County source rows); native CRS EPSG:2264 (NAD83 / North Carolina, US feet)

excluded.other_parcels: NC OneMap returns only this parcel for the site address 5301 DEPARTURE DR in Wake County (p4 attribute query and this geometry query).

operator_structured_data_point_check.use: corroborates the parcel choice; not the locator (no datum or method published)

computed.method: Planar centroid of the WGS84 (outSR=4326) parcel polygon (one record, one ring); cross-checked against the native EPSG:2264 centroid transformed with pyproj; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: TierPoint's Raleigh page (version of 3 September 2026) gives 'Raleigh (RAL) 5301 Departure Drive Raleigh, NC 27616'.
NC OneMap returns one Wake County parcel with site address 5301 DEPARTURE DR (1716964146; 5.37 acres; one structure built in 1982; improvements of about 12.4 million dollars).
TierPoint's own schema.org GeoCoordinates for the page (35.854742, -78.597001) fall inside the same parcel, 29 m from its centroid.
unresolved: The parcel boundary locates the property, not the building footprint; the statewide layer publishes no positional accuracy.
The owner of record is LEVEL 3 COMMUNICATIONS LLC (sale date 30 June 2000); TierPoint's tenure (lease or otherwise) is not published, so no owner role is asserted.
